response.justification: Bogdan has over 12 years of full-stack experience with deep proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS and Docker, directly aligning with the required stack. His hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure, testing frameworks (including Vitest-like tools), and scalable architectures demonstrates strong fit. His open-source contributions and teaching experience further indicate leadership and communication skills.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and AWS
Proven expertise in AI-agent development and testing frameworks
Strong open-source contributions and communication through workshops/talks
concerns: Limited explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in resume
German language skill is only basic, may hinder local collaboration
Some roles use DLang or Ember.js heavily, may require ramp-up on modern enterprise stack
